cards.headline: Form 4 Ibotta Inc: KDT Ibotta Holdings, LLC (10% Owner) For: 9 November
cards.what_happened: KDT Ibotta Holdings, LLC disclosed a 10% ownership stake in Ibotta Inc on 9 November, as reported in a Form 4 filing. The disclosure signals a significant level of control that surpasses Nigeria’s 5% threshold for Persons with Significant Control.
key_facts: KDT Ibotta Holdings, LLC holds 10% of Ibotta Inc
analysis: Why it matters: A 10% stake by a foreign entity constitutes a material control interest, underscoring the importance of transparency for corporate governance and regulatory oversight.
cards.ownership_caveat: Ownership details as reported by Investing.com Nigeria; not verified with CAC records.

cards.headline: FG dismisses alleged irregularities in livestock ministry HQ deal amid procurement questions
cards.what_happened: The Federal Ministry of Livestock Development denied allegations of irregularities in the purchase of its Abuja headquarters. The ministry confirmed that the N8.94 billion payment to Osas & Oseji Estate Surveyors & Valuers on 17 September 2025 complied with government approval and procurement procedures and that the acquisition was necessary for its nascent operations.
key_facts: Acquisition of the Ministry’s headquarters on Aminu Kano Crescent, Wuse II, Abuja
analysis: As reported by Nairametrics; AURA has not checked court or agency records. An allegation or charge is not a finding of guilt.

cards.headline: NGX Group acquires 10% strategic stake in Nairobi Securities Exchange
cards.what_happened: NGX Group Plc has acquired a 10% equity stake in Nairobi Securities Exchange, expanding its investment footprint in East Africa as part of its pan‑African growth strategy.
key_facts: NGX Group Plc acquired 10% equity stake in Nairobi Securities Exchange.
Stake acquisition part of pan‑African growth strategy.
analysis: Why it matters: The move signals Nigerian capital market firms expanding cross‑border influence, potentially attracting more investment into African securities exchanges.

cards.headline: Sunbeth completes N19.5 billion acquisition of UAC’s 73.29% stake in Livestock Feeds, reconstitutes Board
cards.what_happened: Sunbeth Treenuts and Sesame Limited has completed its N19.5 billion all-cash acquisition of UAC of Nigeria Plc's 73.29% stake in Livestock Feeds Plc. The transaction followed approvals from the FCCPC, SEC and NGX, and the company has reconstituted its board with three resignations and five new directors.
key_facts: Sunbeth Treenuts and Sesame Limited acquired UAC of Nigeria Plc's 73.29% stake in Livestock Feeds Plc for N19.5 billion, all cash.
The transaction was announced on September 30, 2026, at an implied price of N8.85 per Livestock Feeds share.
Sam Okuwlehi, Seyi Ebenezer, Professor Franklin Nnaemeka Ngwu, Mary Mulili and Farrukh Siddiqui were appointed directors on November 17, 2026.
analysis: Why it matters: The change of majority ownership and full board turnover at Livestock Feeds shifts control of a listed Nigerian animal feed company to Sunbeth, and the article names Sunbeth as the buyer without disclosing its beneficial owners.
cards.ownership_caveat: Ownership details as reported by Nairametrics; not verified with CAC records.

cards.headline: Billionaire Tony Elumelu adds N98 billion stake in Seplat
cards.what_happened: Heirs Energies, the energy investment company of Tony Elumelu, bought an additional 5,888,341 Seplat Energy Plc shares at a cost of approximately N98 billion. The purchase lifts the Heirs Holdings Group's stake in Seplat to 22.05%, a holding the article values at approximately US$1.6 billion. Elumelu is also set to become Seplat's chairman effective January 1, 2027.
key_facts: Heirs Energies acquired 5,888,341 additional Seplat Energy Plc shares at approximately N98 billion.
The latest purchase brings the Heirs Holdings Group's total Seplat shareholding to 22.05%.
The Group's total Seplat holding is valued at approximately US$1.6 billion.
Elumelu is set to become Seplat Chairman effective January 1, 2027, succeeding Senator Udoma Udo Udoma.
cards.ownership_caveat: Ownership details as reported by Nairametrics; not verified with CAC records.
